reviews.text: I love the best place for your most

I’ve been going to Fluffology for about a year and I’m continuously impressed by their service. I have a reactive and scared Daschund but the staff is always so kind and reassuring. Hannah has been a godsend. She always makes sure my pup is well taken care of and I highly recommend if you’re looking for a groomer in the area.

I went into fluffology last weekend simply because it's a beautiful pet establishment. I didn't expect to buy anything that day but was quickly and warmly welcomed by pet technician Hannah and front of the house Stephanie as well as cute treat snack stations, spacious bathing areas, and even better? Things I actually had saved in an Amazon cart and needed! Hannah helped me pick out the perfect brush for my corgi's unrelenting hair shedding while Stephanie picked out two high salmon/seafood snack supplements as well. They answered all my questions, didn't push on anything in a strictly salesy way and they made me excited to bring my pup here for any and all his grooming and playful needs. PS Dallas loved his treats, both the helpful ones, and the ones I had to get at the snack cart! Thanks to the ladies and will be back! Also GREAT PRICING!!

Worst doodle cut ever.

I asked for a short summer cut with his ears and tail left just a little longer than the rest of his body. Instead, they didn’t trim his ears or tail at all. He came out looking like a furry Dumbo with a giant poofy duster attached to his butt.

They offered to have us come back for a redo, but the whole reason for the appointment was that we were leaving town right afterward, so there wasn’t time. What was especially disappointing was that no partial refund, discount, or credit toward a future grooming was offered.

It’s a shame to lose a groomer so close to home, but after this experience, I can’t justify coming back.

My dog Bernard is not a fan of the groomers, but it finally feels like we’ve found the right spot! Daniel is fantastic with my dog and makes me feel comfortable leaving him there. Bernard always comes out looking amazing! I am very big on overall service, and Stephanie at Fluffology is the best! She is amazing at communicating, always so accommodating, and makes the overall experience feel top tier!

Daniel is a star!
His cut for my Standard Poodle, Jean-Luc, is gorgeous!
He listens to our requests and his judgement is I instinctively right

I am a believer and totally obsessed with how well they took care of Frankie. They explained the grooming process and gave me ample  time to come back to pick him up. Frankie looked amazing with his new haircut. They really know what they’re doing with the golden doodle breed. I will be back for sure and I highly recommend anyone who is thinking about giving this place a try do it you won’t regret it.!

Unfortunately, to me, I had a bad experience. I took my Husky there i tell  the groomer to keep the attention on the nails he just didn't do it well when I came back home, I checked the ears, it was fully of dirt , and only after a week I have so manu hairs come out , it's never happened before when I took my may dog  to the other groomers.
So I don't feel that the $150 is fair price that the provide you .
And then I called then tell that I'm not satisfied and the groomer Tell me, come back again.We will do it, but you need to pay for the second time , i don't feel like I wanna go back there .
First time and I love it. My pup looks amazing with such a shiny coat and the Care in which the groomer took his second to none.

First time visiting Fluffology! My friend gave me a gift card so I was excited to see how my experience would be. 10/10 Genesis took care of my Penny beautifully! It made me really happy to know she also had cared for Cavaliers prior. I loved how she followed my specific grooming instructions! I left very satisfied and will be returning!
They are awesome! Hannah does such a great job with my big fluffy cat every time! He's pretty cranky but they let me stay in the room and help by keeping him calm. Great experience every time!
We are so excited to have found Fluffology!!! They took amazing care with our elderly long-haired kitty. The experience was professional from start to finish!
They truly care and knowledgeable about dogs!
Everything was wonderful everyone was so professional but most of all so nice and welcoming we will definitely be back with Remy 🙂

Hi Melissa,
Thanks so much for the awesome shout out.  We really appreciate it.  Come back soon.

Highly recommend Fluffology! Stephanie and Daniel are great. My dog Teddy really enjoyed it and even got some yummy treats and samples at the end of his groom. It’s hard to find someone you can trust with your dog but I trust them 100% with Teddy and you can tell they really love what they do. Thanks Fluffology! 😍

This was my favorite place until recently. I have a senior Shih Tzu who is a bit finicky with his face and has arthritis, so his back legs fall down a lot. All of this information about him was in the notes from his last visit with Mariana, who had no issues grooming him aside from him, sniping with his face when she still managed to do. An hour later, I got a call back saying I needed to come get my dog because they weren't able to groom him. I was told he would be ready in about an hour and a half to an hour and 45 minutes. They gave him a bath and trimmed his nails (I told them the vet already did  them and probably didn't need to be done). He was supposed to get a teddy bear face summer cut. He struggled when she attempted to trim his face . I, the client, was asked to assist the groomer. It was only with my help that she was able to slightly shave his snoot, shave his paw pads, and clean out his ears. But that was all ! Made excuses of why he couldn’t be groomed - his age, his legs, a lot can change for a dog in a year (he has been groomed by other groomers throughout the year with no problems.) “oh, he’s not a bad dog; he’s just at the age where he shouldn’t be groomed or should be groomed at home. “The groomer claimed that he was flailing all over in the bathtub and biting at the bath hose. I’ve bathed him in my own bath and live in a place that has an on-site doggy washroom, and he never had issues or bit the hose ever, and I’ve never been told that by other groomers either. It had been a year since Mariana had groomed him at this place, and she is no longer there. They tried to say a lot can happen in a year for a senior dog, but he had the same issues the last time. If this groomer wasn’t able to handle senior dogs like they claim, she should’ve canceled the appointment. After assisting her for 20 minutes while she tried to tell me the reason she couldn’t groom him as she attempted to trim his face (and put the bottom end of the shaver on his head to make him see that it wasn’t bad), the owner mentioned this in the phone call after watching the video and tried to use that as an excuse to charge me $50. The groomer told me I would only be charged for his nails, which didn’t even need to be done, as I told them in the beginning. Yet, I agreed to this. I even planned on leaving her a decent tip. My usual is 20%. I planned on leaving her 18% because she was going to only charge me for the nails. Thought I should at least tip her for trying . But when I got to the checkout stand, I was being told I was being charged $50 for bath, trim, and nails. He never had a trim; that was the whole point of me being called in. It was that they couldn’t cut his hair, and they charged me $50 because she was able to shave part of his nose only with my help! She didn’t even get the rest of his face. She didn’t even tell me that she was updating the price because I held him while she talked to my ear off for 15 minutes and  attempted to groom him for five. It had been barely an hour. I requested a call back with the owner, and she defended her staff, the pricing, and insisted that my senior Shih Tzu was just at the age that he shouldn’t be groomed.. Whenever I take him to a groomer who is actually experienced, they have managed to do him perfectly fine. Just mention that he gets snippy when it comes to trimming his face. The front desk girl was really snooty and rude and didn’t even look at me in the eyes as she talked to me and just kept texting on her phone and pursing her lips. She even had the nerve to tell me, “Well, he looks better than when he came in,” obviously because he had a bath. The next day, I set up an appointment at Euphoria Pet Salon and they were able to groom him all the way with zero issues aside from him being finicky with his face and legs slipping due to his arthritis .It’s all smoke and mirrors. Both groomer & owner said they would reach out to Mariana who now has her own grooming place to see if she’d be willing to do him again. They never reached out to me with her info.
I loveeeeeee this place and loveeee LEO!!! My dog looks amazing everytime and they’re so good with him! They make taking my baby to the groomers a great experience!
